card.text: M48 is an open star cluster in the Milky Way, about 747 parsecs away.

sources.label: Hunt & Reffert (2023), Improving the open cluster census. II. An all-sky cluster catalogue with Gaia DR3, A&A 673, A114; CDS J/A+A/673/A114, Table 3 (clusters), NGC_2548: dist50, the median of the maximum-likelihood distance, 747.0835211 pc (16th to 84th percentile 746 to 748)
Wikipedia, "Messier 48"
sources.quote: Messier 48 or M48, also known as NGC 2548, is an open cluster of stars in the equatorial constellation of Hydra.

introduction.text: M48 is drawn as 489 of its member stars, measured by Gaia; each dot sits at its sky position, at the cluster's distance.

sources.quote: It sits near Hydra's westernmost limit with Monoceros, about 18° 34′ to the east and slightly south of Hydra's brightest star, Alphard.
